Combines fast fingerprint recognition, a 2K HD camera with an f/1.6 lens and a video doorbell in one device, so you see every detail at your front door day and night.

An efficient chip and slim fingerprint film recognize you in the blink of an eye. You can also open the door from the eufy Security app, with Alexa or Google Assistant voice commands, from the keypad, or with a key.

See who is at your door through the doorbell camera and manage the lock from the eufy Security app wherever you are, with notifications for every visitor. Thumbnail previews in push notifications are stored temporarily in the cloud.
A large 10000mAh rechargeable battery powers every feature, so you never have to buy replacement batteries.
Built-in local storage protects your privacy with no subscription fees. The BHMA-certified lock is IP65 water resistant and withstands temperatures from -30°C to 70°C.
